graph-anatomy.alt: A line graph of water temperature against heating time for 100 g and 200 g of water. Callouts point to the title, the x-axis label "Time (min)" with an even scale, the y-axis label "Temperature (°C)", the key naming the two lines, and a rise-over-run triangle showing the slope of the 100 g line: 30 °C over 5 min, or 6 °C per minute.
